name: Recast: Bulk Edit for WooCommerce Subscriptions
author: Recast Subscriptions

sections.description:
Recast bulk edits existing WooCommerce Subscriptions. Update the price for existing subscribers, change the next payment date of many subscriptions at once, move subscribers off a product you retire, move subscriptions off a payment method, and put a group on hold. Recast previews every change for each subscription before anything is written.

When you change a subscription product, only new customers get the new terms. Existing subscribers keep their old price, dates and settings. Recast closes that gap.

Free

  • Health check: find subscribers on old prices and the revenue per month you would add, renewals that will fail, overdue renewals, and manual renewals with a saved card. Each finding opens a preview of its fix.
  • Renewal forecast: interactive 7, 14 and 30 day views, daily renewals and amounts, per currency.
  • Select and preview: filter by product, status, payment method, date, currency, tax class or customer. See every field before and after, and the effect on recurring revenue.
  • Every supported change: price, product, payment dates, billing period, status, renewal type, payment method, tax class and custom fields.
  • CSV export of any selection.

Pro

Recast Pro is a separate plugin from recastsubscriptions.com. It applies the changes you preview and adds undo, notice emails and revenue reports.

  • Apply large selections in the background, with pause and stop.
  • Undo a whole batch. Recast skips and reports subscriptions that changed after the preview.
  • Email subscribers before a price change, then apply it after 30 days or more.
  • Report monthly recurring revenue changes as CSV or a printable client page.
  • Keep History and undo after the license ends.

How it works

  1. Select subscriptions with filters.
  2. Choose a change. Example: set a new recurring price, or move the next payment date.
  3. Preview. Recast shows each subscription with its values before and after. Nothing changes yet.
  4. Apply, with Recast Pro. The change runs in the background, and you can undo the whole batch.

A batch is one change on one selection. Recast records every batch in History. Requires WooCommerce 8.0 or newer and WooCommerce Subscriptions 5.0 or newer. WooCommerce Subscriptions is sold separately.

Recast can use Freemius for optional usage data. Recast sends nothing unless you opt in on the welcome screen. You can skip it, and every feature of this plugin keeps working. When you opt in, Recast sends the site URL, the WordPress and plugin versions and, if you choose, your admin email to Freemius. Freemius uses them for usage data and to deliver updates. Freemius also sells Recast Pro. See the Freemius privacy policy and terms.

WooCommerce is a trademark of its owner. This plugin is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the owner of that trademark.

Third-party resources

  • WordPress components and icons by the WordPress Contributors, licensed under GPL-2.0-or-later. WordPress supplies the component runtime.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce and WooCommerce Subscriptions must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Recast.
sections.faq:
How do I update the price of existing WooCommerce subscriptions?

When you change a product’s price, WooCommerce Subscriptions keeps existing subscribers on their old price. The Recast health check finds the subscriptions that pay less than the current price. Select them, choose “Increase or decrease recurring price” and preview the new price for each subscription. To apply the change, use Recast Pro, a separate plugin.

How do I find subscriptions whose renewals will fail?

Open the health check. “Renewals that will fail” lists the automatic renewals that use a payment method that is not installed or is turned off. “Overdue renewals” lists the active subscriptions that are more than a day past their next payment.

Can I change the next payment date of many subscriptions at once?

Recast selects the subscriptions with filters and previews the new next payment date for each one. You can also preview changes to the trial end, end date, billing period, status, payment method and tax class. Recast Pro, a separate plugin, applies the change.

How do I export WooCommerce subscriptions to CSV?

Select subscriptions with filters, then choose Export CSV. Recast exports large selections in the background.

Which payment methods does it work with?

Any payment method that WooCommerce Subscriptions supports, for example Stripe, PayPal and WooPayments. Recast reads the payment method of each subscription. It does not connect to the payment provider.

Does it support High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. Every read and write goes through the WooCommerce Subscriptions API. Both storage modes work.

Does a price change affect new customers?

No. Recast changes only existing subscriptions. Product prices do not change.

What does Recast change?

Recast changes only the existing subscriptions you select. It uses the WooCommerce and WooCommerce Subscriptions APIs, not direct database writes, so High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) works. It does not edit products or past orders, move saved cards between payment methods, or email customers during a normal batch. The optional Recast Pro price rule sends notice emails only after you turn it on.

Can I move subscribers off a product I retire?

Yes. Choose “Move to another product”. The new product must bill on the same schedule as each subscription. Each subscription keeps its price, or gets the new product’s price, and the quantity stays the same. To apply the change, use Recast Pro, a separate plugin.

Does Recast charge customers at once?

A price change applies on the next renewal. If a date change puts the next payment less than 24 hours away, Recast skips that subscription. You can permit immediate charges. Recast asks you to confirm first.

Can I undo a batch?

Yes, with Recast Pro, a separate plugin. It can undo every applied batch. Recast skips subscriptions that changed after the batch, so it does not overwrite newer changes. You can choose to restore them anyway.

Is the free version limited by the size of the selection?

No. Count, preview and export work on a selection of any size.

What are the column names in the CSV file?

The column names are fixed English keys, for example subscription_id and recurring_total. Scripts can rely on them. They do not change with the site language.

Does Recast use the normal WordPress admin?

Yes. Recast opens under WooCommerce > Recast. The WordPress menu, toolbar and messages stay visible. Recast uses WordPress controls and follows your admin color scheme.

My exports folder is public on nginx

On Apache an .htaccess file protects the folder. On nginx, add a rule that denies access to /wp-content/uploads/recast/.
sections.changelog:
0.4.0

  • Updated the Freemius WordPress SDK to 2.13.5, including its security fixes.
  • Redesigned the interface with native WordPress controls, compact Health check results and clearer status text.
  • Added interactive renewal forecasts with 7, 14 and 30 day views, daily values and keyboard navigation.
  • Improved the alignment and phone layouts of selection, change options and preview tables.
  • Removed the full-screen display option. The WordPress menu and toolbar stay visible.
  • Fixed the Account shortcut for sites with no registered license account. License management is now in Settings when available.

0.3.1

  • The plugin is now called Recast Subscriptions Bulk Editor. Nothing else changes.

0.3.0

  • New change: Move to another product. Move the subscriptions on one product or variation to another product with the same billing schedule. Keep each price or use the new product’s price. Every subscription is previewed, and the batch can be undone.

0.2.0

  • Health check: the old prices finding says that Recast Pro can keep subscribers on the current price by itself.
  • Recast Pro: a price rule. When the regular price of a product goes up, Recast sends a notice email to each subscriber who pays less, then applies the new price after 30 days or more, as a batch you can undo.
  • Recast Pro: a monthly report of the recurring revenue your batches changed, with a CSV download and a print view.
  • Recast Pro: undo keeps working after a license ends.

0.1.9

  • History: a batch that was only previewed shows “None” in the Changed column.
  • History: the page text no longer mentions undo, which only Recast Pro can do.

0.1.8

  • First release on WordPress.org.
